text: v1.0.10 is out with the bet slip fix. The paper-record cards, Real/Paper stakes and BoltOdds/SX scores are not built yet, and I haven't written any of that code. The paper records are only journal lines with no results graded against them, so I have to build a grader first, then the Live-board cards, then the stakes switch, then the two score feeds. I'll message you when v1.0.11 is out.
